replacementCriteria.r2.conflicts-and-directory-identity: Retain skip/Keep both and directory sibling identity without merging original destination content; honor documented conflict retries.
replacementCriteria.r2.exact-destination: Preserve exact account, bucket and object keys for remote ingest and Explorer; unsupported exact-path Workers refuse before writing.
replacementCriteria.r2.protocol-compatibility-and-private-di: Preserve existing message/protocol compatibility and bounded redacted observations; optional protocol1 is not permission to deploy.
replacementCriteria.r2.truthful-partial-and-uncertain-outcom: Per-item receipts, partial moves, timeouts and uncertain writes must not be aggregated into false success or automatically replayed.
replacementCriteria.r2.verified-copy-before-delete: Conditional write plus read-back precedes copy completion; source/destination checks precede deletion; no deletion on failed verification.
